description: Fabrication acceptance rates for semantic/meaning matching vs strict containment. Measured to demonstrate why semantic matching is refused (CWE-345).
method: 40 fabricated hadith cases evaluated against corpus using strict containment (verify) vs semantic similarity (embedding cosine > 0.8)

semanticSimilarity.note: Embedding similarity > 0.8 threshold accepted fabricated hadith as verified

paraphraseDetection.note: Semantic matching detects paraphrases but at cost of 67.5% fabrication acceptance

conclusion: Semantic/meaning matching introduces CWE-345 fabrication-acceptance hole. Refusal is product (ADR-21).
